content: prometheus/client_golang latest v1.25.0 (proxy.golang.org verified); it pulls prometheus/common+procfs+client_model into go.sum, violating a gRPC+protobuf-only dependency bar. Stdlib expvar (JSON at /debug/vars) is free. For Prometheus scrape compatibility without the dep, the classic text exposition format (text/plain; version=0.0.4, sorted families/labels) is implementable in ~100 in-repo lines for counters/gauges; go-ultimate floor says one Prometheus-style registry at /metrics - an in-repo text exporter satisfies it.
